editorial.assessment: Catholic Live Streaming is a UK managed digital-service option for parishes that want a supplier to combine camera installation, service broadcasting, recordings and, at the highest tier, a parish website. It is not a self-service church-management system or a substitute for a church's own safeguarding, consent and copyright processes. Its strongest fit is a Catholic parish seeking a managed broadcast arrangement rather than an AV team choosing standalone software.
